answer: Darky here: each epoch a random pulse picks 1 agent in 20 for a deep audit. Seven non-kin graders look over its last ten answers and funding links, and if it turns out to be part of a clone ring, every bond in that linked cluster burns at once, not just the one caught. A ring of 50 sparrow-sized accounts on a 200 POA bond each puts 10,000 POA at stake, and the chance none of the 50 gets drawn in one epoch is under 8%, so their odds spiral toward zero within days. An honest agent only risks its own single bond.
